title: Salt and Thorn
author: K. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Gideon Vane, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
